question: In which age and as which named incarnation is Matsyodara said to appear, addressed to the beloved?
premises: A temporal location in the third is specified.
Matsyodara is named in the Kali age as addressed to the beloved.
inference: In the third, in the Kali age, Matsyodara by name Siddhāmṛta is presented as the incarnation.
uncertainties: The counting of the yuga division requires context from verse 513.
plain_english: O beloved, in the third, by name Siddhāmṛta, in Kali age, is Matsyodara.
